title: Detective Conan
synopsis: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

bonus.title: Opening Theme 1 | Mune ga Dokidoki by  ↑THE HIGH-LOWS↓ [Subtitled]

episodes.title: The Big Shrink
episodes.synopsis: While on a date with Rachel, Kudo is attacked by two shady thugs who slip him an experimental drug. The effects of the poison will turn Jimmy’s life upside down!

episodes.title: The Kidnapped Debutante
episodes.synopsis: Conan sets out to discover the fate of a wealthy businessman’s kidnapped daughter. His new identity is a secret to everyone but his eccentric inventor friend, Dr. Agasa.

episodes.title: Beware of Idols
episodes.synopsis: Pop diva Yoko Okino is being stalked and she's come to star-struck Richard Moore's doorstep for help! Luckily for all involved, Conan is on the job, too.

episodes.title: Fish Marks the Spot
episodes.synopsis: Treasure hunt! When a mysterious coded map ends up in the hands of Conan and his new friends from school, the Junior Detective League is born!

episodes.title: The Time Bomb Express
episodes.synopsis: On a cross country train, Conan comes across two sketchy men that might be connected to the night of his big shrink! To make matters worse, the hoods are packing a bomb!

episodes.title: Tragic Valentine
episodes.synopsis: When Rachel and Serena attend a Valentine’s Day dinner party with some boys, Conan decides to tag along. It’s a good thing, too, because murder is on the menu!

episodes.title: The Case of Mysterious Gifts
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Woodman has been receiving children’s toys - and cash - once a month for the last two years, and he has no idea why. Conan and Richard take the case and find some interesting twists along the way.

episodes.title: The Art Museum Murder Case
episodes.synopsis: The owner of an art museum is killed by what appears to be someone wearing medieval body armor from the 15th century. Can Conan bring the killer to justice?

episodes.title: Festival Fiasco
episodes.synopsis: An author scripts the perfect murder of his ex-partner, complete with an airtight alibi. Can Conan see through the holes in his plot, or has this writer penned himself a perfect happy ending?

episodes.title: Deadly Game
episodes.synopsis: A star soccer player's been thrown off his game. A girl claiming to be Jimmy's girlfriend has surfaced, asking for help in finding a kidnapped boy. Are the events connected?

episodes.title: The Moonlight Sonata Murder Case (1/2)
episodes.synopsis: There is murder abound on Moonlight Island, and with every victim that is found, the haunting sounds of a classical composition are heard. Conan must solve the crime before all the suspects disappear!

episodes.title: Kidnapped: Ayumi
episodes.synopsis: An innocent game of hide-and-seek becomes a race through the city when two thugs kidnap Amy. With the clock running against them, can the Junior Detective League rescue her before it's too late?
